text:
morgan: heads-up — bringing up Pyxis' adapter (LoRA) on int8 profile, ran the light eval pack. seeing weird drop on numeric extraction cases.

javi: thanks — can you paste the quick numbers? rough is fine.

morgan: top-line: QA_F1 went from 0.86 (fp16 baseline) -> 0.77 (int8). exact-match down 9%.

sophia: ouch. Is this the stock int8 recipe or our 'safe' int8 profile?

morgan: safe profile (per recommendations) — quantize-only, no per-channel folding.

samir: any diffs in tokenizer/merging? sometimes LoRA merges + quant wrap up tokens slightly.

morgan: merged with adapter_stitch v1.3 (usual flow). tokenizer consistent. I ran a deterministic seed.

morgan: pasted the short eval snippet:
```
# run quickpack
python eval/quick_eval.py --model pyxis-lora-merged --quant int8-safe --evalset pyxis-qa-small --seed 42
# outputs: metrics.json
```

morgan: metrics.json excerpt:
```
{
  "qa_f1": 0.77,
  "exact_match": 0.71,
  "avg_latency_ms": 68
}
```

javi: latency looks fine. quality drop is the issue. Do we have per-example diffs?

morgan: yes — dumping 10 worst diffs to S3: s3://redwood-temp/pyxis/int8-worst10.tsv

sophia: I'll pull those. quick hypothesis: LoRA scale + int8 calibration mismatch. Did you calibrate on fp16 outputs or fused int8 traces?

morgan: calibrated using 1k random in-domain samples through our calib runner (same as usual).

samir: can you try the alternate calibration set — "calib-strict" (more long-tail) and rerun one batch? should be quick.

morgan: kicked off a rerun with calib-strict now. CI bot says job 8342 queued.

ci-bot: Job 8342 started on runner-infer-07. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/8342

javi: also try the int8-with-kv-clamp flag — we've seen it mitigate numeric extraction failures before.

morgan: good call. will run both: calib-strict and kv-clamp. expecting ~10-15m each.

sophia: if that doesn't help, try fp16 quant-aware merge (i.e., keep LOra in fp16, quantize base). avoids double-quantizing adapter weights.

morgan: noted. plan: 1) calib-strict 2) kv-clamp 3) fp16-lora + int8-base. reporting back results.

aml-ops: FYI — Pyxis is on Dedicated trial; throttling is off but if we need longer runs ping me for extra quota.

morgan: thanks — will ping if we need a bigger eval sweep.

javi: thanks for quick triage. small requests: attach worst-case prompts in thread and mark any safety or hallucination issues so we can rule them out. :thumbsup:

morgan: will upload worst prompts + a short notebook with diff visualization once runs finish.

samir: if kv-clamp helps, add a short note to the quant recommendation doc with the exact flag and threshold you used.

morgan: on it. updating here after Job 8342 completes (or earlier if we see signal).
